title.label: For $30 it should be more accurate

content.label: I used this app for 2 months doing everything from texts, writing for work, etc. for $30 it should not have been such an exercise in frustration. I have a very slight accent from a European accent, that’s not my delusional self assessment a lot of people don’t even hear it. Except this app. But it doesn’t think I’m from a European country, oh no, it thinks I say completely different words than I do and every 3rd paragraph has mandarin in it. I don’t speak mandarin. No I did not enable mandarin. Uninstalled it now I can’t deal with the constant corrections that are cumbersome and slow because once it has decided you said a certain thing it will stick to it even if you try to enunciate very very clearly.
